summary: The Hodge-structure content itself is new, but the base-change scaffolding restates Mathlib verbatim (`TensorProduct.isBaseChange`), a second unused conjugation API is built on `Complexification V`, and several long proofs re-derive located Mathlib lemmas (`Submodule.map_top`/`LinearEquiv.range`, `Submodule.map_inf`, `TensorProduct.map_comp`/`map_id`, `Int.leInductionDown`), with two copies each of the `map ⊤ = ⊤` and `IsCompl (F (p+1)) …` derivations.
